description: TEAMER: Results of Investigating Structural Design Concepts and Alternative Materials for a Wave Power System is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Christian Whitney, Maxim Veilleux. Included here are materials from a study on the design of a three-body Wave Energy Converter (WEC) utilizing a heave plate, dual Power Take Offs (PTOs), and single point mooring. A material trade study has been conducted to evaluate the effects of introducing various metallic and fiber-reinforced polymer (FRP) elements to the design. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
